meta.title: Worship Flow
meta.description: ProPresenter, video production, creative media and automation for churches. Your team opens a ready-to-run file every Sunday.

sections.kicker: ProPresenter, video and creative media for churches
sections.title: Open the file. Run Sunday.
sections.body: Worship Flow is your church's ProPresenter and creative partner. Playlists, lyrics, sermon slides, video and graphics are prepared during the week, so your volunteers walk in to a service that is ready to run.
sections.note: Last-minute changes are welcome until Saturday at 7 PM.
sections.consoleHint: Click any slide to take it live

slides.line: One cue fires slides, lights and cameras

sections.title: Four specialties, one creative partner
sections.body: More than a decade of church production, from church plants to multi-campus teams.

items.title: ProPresenter
items.body: Weekly playlists, styled lyrics, crafted sermon slides and remote management. We keep your library clean and your themes consistent, and your team opens a file that is ready to run.

items.title: Video production and editing
items.body: Story videos, announcements, website hero videos and three-camera livestreams.

items.title: Creative media
items.body: Series graphics, announcement slides, digital signs and social content that match your church's look.

items.title: Automation
items.body: ProPresenter, ATEM and Lightkey talking to each other through RossTalk and MIDI, so one click fires slides, cameras and lights.

items.title: Training
items.body: Volunteer training, ProPresenter operator coaching and on-site city-wide training events.

items.title: Live events
items.body: A ProPresenter machine with four outputs and an operator who runs the whole event. We built every file for a conference with 6 stages and more than 70 presenters.

sections.title: On site for your event
sections.body: Conferences, camps and city-wide nights. We bring a ProPresenter machine with four outputs and an operator who runs the whole event, and we can add a three-camera livestream.
facts: Every ProPresenter file built for a conference with 6 stages and 70+ presenters
Three-camera livestream to YouTube, Facebook or RTMP

sections.title: Media you can use this Sunday
sections.body: Templates, motion and graphics built for real services. Buy once, download, and drop them into your playlist.

items.title: Sermon series graphics pack
items.desc: Title slide, content slide, lower third and social squares in one matched set.

items.title: Clean lyric theme set
items.desc: ProPresenter themes for lyrics, scripture and sermon points, sized for main screen and stream.

items.title: Slow haze motion backgrounds
items.desc: Ten seamless loops in 4K that sit quietly behind lyrics.

items.title: Five-minute countdown
items.desc: A pre-service countdown with matching welcome and announcement slides.

items.title: ATEM and Lightkey macro starter
items.desc: RossTalk and MIDI actions you can import, with a setup walkthrough video.

items.title: Christmas service bundle
items.desc: Stills, motion and lower thirds for Advent and Christmas Eve.

sections.title: Your week, from plan to Sunday
sections.body: Onboarding takes one 30 to 45 minute meeting. After that, every week runs the same way.

items.title: Share your service plan
items.body: Planning Center, chord charts, a Word document or a quick call.

items.title: Rehearsal file built
items.body: Worship, sermon and media organized in ProPresenter.

items.title: Rehearse and send changes
items.body: Notes, a recording or a simple form. Your operator doesn't have to be there.

items.title: Final flow with sermon notes
items.body: Scripture, points and graphics added to the service.

items.title: Final check
items.body: Lyrics, scriptures, layouts and cues reviewed. Late changes still accepted.

items.title: Open and run
items.body: Your team walks in to a ready-to-run file.

sections.title: Led by Steve Dirks
sections.body: Steve is a production leader with a pastoral heart, based in Pittsburgh. He has run ProPresenter for church plants and multi-campus churches for more than a decade, leads audio, video and lighting teams, and edits video professionally.
sections.body2: People first. Purpose behind every cue.

sections.title: Tell us about your Sunday
sections.body: A 30 minute call is the fastest way to see whether we're a fit. Bring your questions, your ProPresenter version and whatever is frustrating your team.
